scope: Fresh depolarising simulation on all 940 mirrored Qermit targets, one fixed acquisition per target. The archived raw, ZNE and CDR estimates come from a separate acquisition.
acquisition: Modern Qermit 0.9.3 simulator replay. A binomial draw from the noiseless or noisy channel parity distribution supplies each observed expectation.
estimand: Within each family, width and depth cell, compute each target’s absolute error divided by the fresh raw absolute error, then take the median and maximum. Count strict improvements over the baseline cell statistic. Count undefined cells separately.
source_check: Checked all 940 experiment IDs, circuit IDs, families, mirror flags, widths, depths, ideal targets and raw/CDR/ZNE archival estimates against the independent release digest. All 282 archive cell–method rows reproduce the source-linked published reference.

channel_mean_diagnostic.range_rule: Inclusive minimum and maximum of the 20 auxiliary channel means, before shot sampling.
channel_mean_diagnostic.fit: Affine fit of exact ideal labels to noisy channel means, evaluated at the target channel mean.
